name: britt
description: A collection of skills for Claude Code to enhance AI-assisted development workflows

plugins.name: claude-code-skills
plugins.description: All skills bundled together for AI-assisted development: project setup, product specs, user stories, verification plans, daily planning, and more

plugins.name: project-foundations
plugins.description: A curated bundle for taking a new project from concept to a diagrammed, story-driven plan: project setup, issue decomposition, user stories, verification plans, and architecture/dependency/Mermaid diagrams

plugins.name: architecture-diagramming
plugins.description: Generate Mermaid architecture diagrams showing system components, layers, and data flows

plugins.name: at-risk-detection
plugins.description: Proactively identify at-risk issues and PRs: stale items, blocked work, deadline risks, scope creep, and unassigned high-priority items

plugins.name: build-faq-from-issues

plugins.name: consolidate-notes-summary
plugins.description: Search project notes by topic, synthesize findings into a consolidated summary with cross-references

plugins.name: context-aware-questions
plugins.description: Proactively identify information gaps in project context and generate actionable questions to surface missing requirements, unclear specifications, or documentation gaps

plugins.name: daily-planning-ritual
plugins.description: Interactive daily planning ritual across work and personal life dimensions

plugins.name: dependency-mapping
plugins.description: Generate Mermaid dependency graphs showing issue relationships, blocking chains, and critical paths

plugins.name: idea-to-design
plugins.description: Turn an idea note into a design document, plan an idea, or make an idea real

plugins.name: issue-decomposition
plugins.description: Decompose project descriptions into well-structured GitHub issues with user stories, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and estimates

plugins.name: markdown-formatting
plugins.description: Format AI outputs into consistent, readable Markdown for PRs, issues, docs, and notes

plugins.name: mermaid-diagrams
plugins.description: Guide for creating syntactically correct Mermaid diagrams that render properly on GitHub

plugins.name: prepare-meeting-agenda

plugins.name: project-analysis

plugins.name: project-planning
plugins.description: Orchestrate comprehensive project planning - decompose projects into issues, generate architecture diagrams, map dependencies, and create timelines

plugins.name: requirement-elicitation
plugins.description: Adaptive conversational wizard for eliciting project requirements across functional, nonfunctional, and edge-case dimensions

plugins.name: research-topic-summarize
plugins.description: Research topics via web search, synthesize detailed summaries with sources and screenshots

plugins.name: setting-up-a-project
plugins.description: Author CLAUDE.md with project purpose, tech stack, and development practices

plugins.name: stakeholder-tracking
plugins.description: Define stakeholder personas and track their goals to ensure all perspectives are addressed

plugins.description: Craft clear, concise stakeholder communications with appropriate context and framing

plugins.description: Generate Mermaid Gantt charts for project timelines with phases, dependencies, and milestones

plugins.description: Guided workflow for reading, understanding, and implementing GitHub issues

plugins.description: Write comprehensive product specification documents

plugins.description: Create real-world acceptance testing procedures
